annotations.title: Show AI visibility for a tracked brand

description: Use this when someone asks how visible their brand is in AI answers, what their share of AI voice is, or how they compare with competitors. Reads the results CueScout already collected for the brand: how often AI answers named it, its share of voice, how often its site was cited, and the same for each competitor, over the last 7, 28 or 90 days. It does not run new checks.

brand.description: Which brand, by name or id, when the account tracks more than one. Leave empty to use the only brand; list_brands shows them all.

days.description: The window to report on, in days. Defaults to 28.

name: get_ai_visibility
title: Show AI visibility for a tracked brand
